blocker.summary: r476 (Piste A of the approved plan) ran a targeted early-boot oracle capture end to end (sealed route mission01-qualified-96.steps truncated via --duration 60, full dump-to-translate-to-merge pipeline reused from r471/r472). Result: 10/10 translations succeeded but ZERO were genuinely new -- all 10 exactly match entries already in the 320-entry registry, since r470's flight route itself passes through this same title-screen content before reaching flight. This corrects the r475/r476 premise: the gap is not missing shader coverage. Added a local diagnostic trace (AC6_NATIVE_VD_TRACE-gated, not committed) right before draw_pinned()'s 'active shader is not pinned' error, printing actual digests/modifications tried. Live probe: rejected draws always fail on the VERTEX side (pixel_ok=1 consistently), and 2 of 3 rejected vertex digests are EXACTLY the ones captured this cycle -- but under the WRONG modification (0x1/0x900000000 captured vs 0x900000000/0x0 needed by the real draws). The shader IS registered, just not under the (shader, modification) pair this specific draw needs. ctest 11/11, no regression. Named for r477: a precisely-targeted re-capture (different timing, likely past a transient loading/error screen the 60s-truncated run also passed through per RESULT.json's step-02-failure-observation.png) to capture the SAME already-identified vertex shaders under the RIGHT modification -- a narrow target (2-3 shaders), not blind exploration. Still open, independent: Piste B (commit the stabilized native backlog) and Piste C (HUD guard-rail) from the approved plan.
